text: {"lessons":["I should base buy and sell decisions on future prospects and portfolio risk, not on my average cost; waiting to sell losing positions just to avoid realizing a loss can deepen the damage.","Taking a gain can feel satisfying, but I should avoid selling winners automatically while holding losers—review each position consistently and rebalance based on its merits.","Frequent account checks and trading can amplify emotional reactions to losses; I should use a disciplined plan, diversify, and make decisions for the long term."]}
